scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @hellodoc/api" "npm run dev -w @hellodoc/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hellodoc/api && npm run build -w @hellodoc/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hellodoc/api && npm run typecheck -w @hellodoc/web
scripts.db:up: echo Docker is optional. Use local PostgreSQL and scripts/bootstrap-local-postgres.sql
scripts.db:down: echo Docker is optional for HelloDoc local development.
